review: independent implementation; no network; only completed checkpoint-selected full responses
fullrow_hash_recipe: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(comma,colon)

nfkc_remove_whitespace_plus_upper_candid.scope: Case-insensitive candidate matching only; uppercasing is an extra transform beyond NFKC and whitespace removal.

snapshot_scope: New public view is collected page by page at current request observations, not an atomic transaction snapshot. Dates in rows do not certify public availability at historical freeze. Matching model names does not certify same tax configuration. Repeated uuid rows must remain when full-row hashes differ. NFKC/Unicode whitespace is candidate matching only.
